card.name: Punctuation inside boxed warning headings
card.fires_on: Semicolons, hyphens and word endings inside capitalized boxed-warning headings and hyphenated names like HIV-1 or COX-2. It is strongest where the next word is a new warning item.

modes.label: Semicolons in warning headings
modes.description: Semicolon separating items in an all-caps boxed warning list.
modes.example: ADDICTION, ABUSE, AND MISUSE; LIFE-THREATENING RESPIRATORY DEPRESSION; ACCIDENTAL EXPOSURE<<;>> NEONATAL OPIOID WITHDRAW

modes.label: Hyphen in HIV-1 or COX-2
modes.description: Hyphen between a name and its number in a virus or enzyme name.
modes.example: in patients who are coinfected with HIV<<->>1 and HBV and discontinue STR

modes.label: Partway through LIFE-THREATENING
modes.description: The ending ING in LIFE-THREATENING within a warning heading.
modes.example: WARNING: SERIOUS AND LIFE-THREATEN<<ING>> RISKS FROM USE OF HYD
